name: Mmalite Ọrụ Onye Na-anya Forklift
objectives: Mgbe e nyere gị foto ma ọ bụ nkọwa forklift, ịmata ụdị forklift ahụ ma gosi akụkụ ya ndị bụ isi, na-akpọ aha opekata mpe akụkụ 6 na ọrụ nke ọ bụla
Site n'iji ndepụta nlele, ime nlele tupu ọrụ amalite ma kpebie ma e nwere ike iji ụgbọ ahụ, na-elele ihe ọ bụla dị na ndepụta ma na-ewepụ ụgbọ ọ bụla na-adịghị mma n'ọrụ
Mgbe e nyere gị data plate na nkọwa ibu, ikpebi ma ibu ahụ dị mma iweli ma kọwaa ihe kpatara ya, na-enweta opekata mpe mkpebi ibu 4 n'ime 5 ziri ezi
Mgbe e nyere gị ọnọdụ ịnya ụgbọ, ịtụkọ ibu, dock ma ọ bụ ịdọba ụgbọ, ịhọrọ ihe kacha enweghị nsogbu dị ka iwu OSHA si kwuo, na-enweta opekata mpe ọnọdụ 4 n'ime 5 ziri ezi

Site n'iji ihe OSHA chọrọ n'aka ndị were mmadụ n'ọrụ, ide atụmatụ ka a zụọ gị ma nyochaa gị, na otu ahịrị eziokwu maka résumé, nke na-akpọ aha ọrụ onye were gị n'ọrụ ma na-adịghị ekwu na i nwere asambodo i nweghị

chapters.name: Isi 1: Ọrụ ahụ, ụgbọ ahụ na nlele kwa ụbọchị

lessons.title: Ihe ọmụmụ 1: Ọrụ forklift na iwu ọzụzụ OSHA
lessons.text:
Ihe ọmụmụ 1 n'ime 6 · ihe dị ka nkeji 5
Ebumnuche: Kọwaa onye na-azụ ma na-enye onye na-anya forklift asambodo, na mgbe ọ ga-amụgharị ihe.
Ihe ọmụmụ a na-akwado gị maka: Site n'iji ihe OSHA chọrọ n'aka ndị were mmadụ n'ọrụ, ị ga-enwe ike ide atụmatụ ka a zụọ gị ma nyochaa gị, na otu ahịrị eziokwu maka résumé, nke na-akpọ aha ọrụ onye were gị n'ọrụ ma na-adịghị ekwu na i nwere asambodo i nweghị.
OSHA na-akpọ forklift "powered industrial trucks". Iwu ya, 29 CFR 1910.178, kwuru na onye were mmadụ n'ọrụ ga-ahụ na onye ọ bụla na-anya ya maara ọrụ ahụ nke ọma. Nke a pụtara ọzụzụ (klaasị na omume aka n'okpuru onye nkuzi tozuru etozu) na nyocha gị mgbe ị na-anya ụgbọ n'ezi ebe ọrụ ahụ.
Mgbe ahụ, onye were gị n'ọrụ na-ekwenye na a zụrụ gị ma nyochaa gị. Ndekọ ahụ na-egosi aha gị, ụbọchị ọzụzụ na nyocha, na ndị mere ha. A ga-emegharị nyocha gị opekata mpe otu ugboro n'afọ atọ ọ bụla.
Ị ga-enwetakwa ọzụzụ ọzọ (refresher) ma ọ bụrụ na a hụ gị ka ị na-anya ụgbọ n'ụzọ dị ize ndụ, i nwee ihe mberede ma ọ bụ ihe fọrọ nke nta (near miss), nyocha gị adịghị mma, e bufee gị n'ụdị ụgbọ ọzọ, ma ọ bụ ebe ọrụ ahụ gbanwee n'ụzọ metụtara nchekwa.
Iwu ọrụ gọọmentị etiti anaghị ekwe ka onye ọ bụla dị n'okpuru afọ 18 nya forklift n'ọrụ. Ihe ọmụmụ n'ịntanetị ma ọ bụ kaadị akpa naanị anaghị eme ka i nwee asambodo: naanị ọzụzụ na nyocha onye were gị n'ọrụ na-eme ya.
Okwu ị kwesịrị ịmara:
- OSHA: Occupational Safety and Health Administration, ụlọ ọrụ gọọmentị US na-ahụ maka nchekwa n'ebe ọrụ.
- Powered industrial truck: aha OSHA na-akpọ forklift na igwe ndị yiri ya na-ebuli ma na-ebugharị ibu.
- Nyocha (evaluation): onye tozuru etozu na-ele gị anya ka ị na-anya ụgbọ n'ebe ọrụ iji mata ma ị na-anya ya n'enweghị nsogbu.
- Ọzụzụ ọzọ (refresher training): ọzụzụ ọzọ iji dozie nsogbu ma ọ bụ kwadoo gị maka ụgbọ ọhụrụ ma ọ bụ ebe ọrụ ọhụrụ.
- Near miss: ihe mere nke na-emerụghị onye ọ bụla ahụ, mana o nwere ike imerụ mmadụ.
Ebe ozi a pụrụ ịtụkwasị obi:
- OSHA 29 CFR 1910.178: Powered industrial trucks (the federal forklift rule)
- OSHA eTool: Operator training
- 29 CFR 570.58: No forklift operation by workers under 18 (U.S. Department of Labor rule, Cornell LII copy)
Nwaa ugbu a: N'akwụkwọ, dee ahịrịokwu atọ n'okwu nke gị: onye na-azụ ma na-enyocha onye na-anya forklift, ugboro ole a na-emegharị nyocha ahụ, na ihe abụọ mere nke pụtara na ị chọrọ ọzụzụ ọzọ.
Ugbu a ị nwere ike ịkọwa onye na-azụ ma na-enye onye na-anya forklift asambodo, ugboro ole a na-enyocha gị, na mgbe ị chọrọ ọzụzụ ọzọ.

check.q: Onye ga-azụ ma nyochaa gị tupu ị nya forklift n'ọrụ?
options: Onye were gị n'ọrụ, n'ebe ọrụ gị
check.why: Iwu OSHA tinyere ọzụzụ na nyocha n'aka onye were gị n'ọrụ, n'ezi ebe ọrụ ahụ.

check.q: Forklift gị kụrụ shelf (rack). Ọ dịghị onye merụrụ ahụ. Gịnị bụ eziokwu?
options: Ọ bụ ihe kpatara ọzụzụ ọzọ
check.why: Ihe mberede ma ọ bụ near miss bụ otu n'ime ihe OSHA kwuru na-akpata ọzụzụ ọzọ.

lessons.title: Ihe ọmụmụ 2: Ụdị forklift na akụkụ ya
lessons.text:
Ihe ọmụmụ 2 n'ime 6 · ihe dị ka nkeji 5
Ebumnuche: Mata ụdị forklift ahụ ma kpọọ aha akụkụ ya ndị bụ isi.
Ihe ọmụmụ a na-akwado gị maka: Mgbe e nyere gị foto ma ọ bụ nkọwa forklift, ị ga-enwe ike ịmata ụdị forklift ahụ ma gosi akụkụ ya ndị bụ isi, na-akpọ aha opekata mpe akụkụ 6 na ọrụ nke ọ bụla.
OSHA kewara forklift n'otu (class) asaa. Class I: ụgbọ eletrik a na-anọdụ ala anya. Class II: ụgbọ eletrik maka ụzọ dị warara. Class III: ụgbọ eletrik a na-eji aka eduzi, gụnyere pallet jack a na-eje ije n'azụ ya. Class IV na V: ụgbọ nwere injin, nwere taya siri ike maka ala dị ezigbo larịị n'ime ụlọ (IV) ma ọ bụ taya ikuku maka n'èzí (V). Class VI: tractor na-adọkpụ ihe. Class VII: forklift maka ala ọjọọ, n'ebe a na-ewu ụlọ na n'ugbo.
Ọtụtụ forklift counterbalance nwere otu akụkụ ndị bụ isi. Forks na-ebuli ibu. Forks kwụ n'elu carriage, nke na-arịgo ma na-arịda na mast. Load backrest na-egbochi ibu ịdaghachi n'azụ n'ebe ị nọ. Overhead guard na-echebe gị pụọ n'ihe na-ada site n'elu. Counterweight dị n'azụ na-eme ka ibu ahụ ha nhata.
N'oche, i nwere steering, ihe nchịkwa ụzọ (n'ihu na n'azụ), lever iweli na ịtụgharị (tilt), horn, breki na seatbelt. Data plate (a na-akpọkwa ya capacity plate ma ọ bụ nameplate) na-agwa gị ibu ole ụgbọ ahụ nwere ike iweli.
Okwu ị kwesịrị ịmara:
- Mast: osisi ígwè kwụ ọtọ forks na-arịgo ma na-arịda na ya.
- Carriage: efere dị na mast na-ejide forks.
- Load backrest: ígwè dị n'elu forks na-egbochi ibu ịdaghachi n'ebe onye na-anya ya nọ.
- Overhead guard: ígwè dị ka ụlọ n'elu isi na-echebe onye na-anya ya pụọ n'ihe na-ada.
- Counterweight: ihe dị arọ nke ukwuu n'azụ ụgbọ ahụ na-eme ka ibu ahụ ha nhata.
- Data plate: efere dị n'ụgbọ ahụ na-egosi ụdị ya na ibu ole ọ nwere ike iweli.
Ebe ozi a pụrụ ịtụkwasị obi:
- OSHA eTool: Forklift types (Classes I to VII)
- OSHA eTool: Forklift parts
Nwaa ugbu a: See foto dị mfe nke forklift a na-anọdụ ala anya, si n'akụkụ (igbe na ahịrị dị mma). Dee aha opekata mpe akụkụ isii: forks, carriage, mast, load backrest, overhead guard, counterweight. N'akụkụ nke ọ bụla, dee otu ahịrị gbasara ọrụ ya.
Ugbu a ị nwere ike ikwu otu (class) forklift dị na ya ma kpọọ aha akụkụ ya ndị bụ isi na ọrụ ha.

check.q: Kedu akụkụ na-egbochi ibu ịdaghachi n'ebe onye na-anya ya nọ?
check.why: Load backrest dị n'elu forks ma na-egbochi ibu ịda n'ebe ị nọ.

check.q: Forklift e mere maka ala na-adịghị larịị n'ebe a na-ewu ụlọ dị na otu (class) ole?
check.why: Class VII bụ forklift maka ala ọjọọ na-adịghị larịị n'èzí.

lessons.title: Ihe ọmụmụ 3: Nlele tupu ọrụ amalite
lessons.text:
Ihe ọmụmụ 3 n'ime 6 · ihe dị ka nkeji 6
Ebumnuche: Mezue ndepụta nlele tupu ọrụ amalite ma kpebie ma ụgbọ ahụ dị mma iji.
Ihe ọmụmụ a na-akwado gị maka: Site n'iji ndepụta nlele, ị ga-enwe ike ime nlele tupu ọrụ amalite ma kpebie ma e nwere ike iji ụgbọ ahụ, na-elele ihe ọ bụla dị na ndepụta ma na-ewepụ ụgbọ ọ bụla na-adịghị mma n'ọrụ.
OSHA chọrọ ka a lelee forklift ọ bụla tupu e jiri ya, opekata mpe otu ugboro kwa ụbọchị; ọ bụrụ na ụgbọ na-arụ ọrụ ehihie na abalị, mgbe shift ọ bụla gwụrụ. Ọ bụrụ na ihe ọ bụla na-eme ka ụgbọ ahụ dị ize ndụ, a na-ewepụ ya n'ọrụ ruo mgbe a rụziri ya.
Malite mgbe igodo gbanyụrụ. Lelee mmiri ọkụ na mmanụ niile, ma lee ma e nwere ihe na-asọpụta, mgbawa, ma ọ bụ hose na mast chains mebiri emebi (etinyela aka gị n'ime mast mgbe ọ bụla). Lelee taya, forks, load backrest, overhead guard, ma hụ na data plate na akara ịdọ aka na ntị dị n'ọnọdụ ha ma a na-agụ ha nke ọma. Lelee seatbelt.
Ụgbọ eletrik: lelee waya, ihe njikọ na ihe na-ejide batrị. Ụgbọ propane: lelee na e kwụnyere tank nke ọma, na relief valve chere ihu n'elu, na gas anaghị asọpụta.
Mgbe ahụ, mgbe ụgbọ na-agba, nwalee breki, steering, n'ihu na n'azụ, iweli, iwedata, ịtụgharị (tilt), horn, ọkụ na mkpu na-ada mgbe ị na-agba azụ. Ọ bụrụ na ihe adịghị mma: ejila ụgbọ ahụ, kee ya akara (tag) ma ọ bụ kọọ ya, dee ya na ndepụta ma gwa onye isi gị. Naanị ndị a zụrụ azụ ma nye ikike na-arụzi ya.
Nzọụkwụ n'otu n'otu:
- Igodo gbanyụrụ: mmanụ, ihe na-asọpụta, hose na chains (lee anya, etinyela aka).
- Taya, forks, load backrest, overhead guard.
- Data plate na akara ịdọ aka na ntị dị ma a na-agụ ha; seatbelt na-arụ ọrụ.
- Igodo gbanyere: breki, steering, n'ihu na n'azụ.
- Iweli, iwedata, tilt, horn, ọkụ, mkpu ịgba azụ.
- Bịanye aka na ndepụta; kọọ ma kee akara (tag) mmebi ọ bụla, ejikwala ụgbọ ahụ.
Okwu ị kwesịrị ịmara:
- Nlele tupu ọrụ amalite (pre-shift inspection): nlele forklift tupu e jiri ya maka shift ahụ.
- N'ọrụ adịghị (out of service): a gaghị eji ya ruo mgbe a rụziri ya; a na-akakarị ya akara (tag).
- Mast chains: chain ndị na-ebuli carriage na forks n'elu mast.
Ebe ozi a pụrụ ịtụkwasị obi:
- OSHA eTool: Pre-operation inspection
- OSHA 29 CFR 1910.178: Powered industrial trucks (the federal forklift rule)
Nwaa ugbu a: Dee ndepụta nlele nke gị nwere kọlụm abụọ, "Igodo gbanyụrụ" na "Igodo gbanyere", site n'iji peeji OSHA gbasara nlele tupu ọrụ. Wee gụọ okwu omume a: horn anaghị arụ ọrụ, otu fork nwekwara mgbawa. Dee ihe ị ga-eme, nzọụkwụ n'otu n'otu.
Ugbu a ị nwere ike imezue ndepụta nlele tupu ọrụ amalite ma wepụ ụgbọ na-adịghị mma n'ọrụ.

check.q: Ugboro ole ka a ga-elele forklift tupu e jiri ya?
options: Opekata mpe kwa ụbọchị, tupu e jiri ya
check.why: OSHA chọrọ nlele tupu e jiri ya, opekata mpe kwa ụbọchị, na mgbe shift ọ bụla gwụrụ ma ọ na-arụ ehihie na abalị.

check.q: Mgbe ị na-elele, breki adịghị ike. Gịnị ka ị ga-eme?
options: Kọọ ya, kee ya akara n'ọrụ adịghị, ejikwala ya
Gwa onye ọrụ ibe gị ka o jiri ya
check.why: A na-ewepụ ụgbọ na-adịghị mma n'ọrụ ma kọọ ya; naanị ndị nwere ikike na-arụzi ya.

chapters.name: Isi 2: Ibu, ịnya ụgbọ na inweta ọrụ

lessons.title: Ihe ọmụmụ 4: Ịgụ data plate na ịtụ ibu
lessons.text:
Ihe ọmụmụ 4 n'ime 6 · ihe dị ka nkeji 6
Ebumnuche: Jiri data plate na load center kpebie ma ibu dị mma iweli.
Ihe ọmụmụ a na-akwado gị maka: Mgbe e nyere gị data plate na nkọwa ibu, ị ga-enwe ike ikpebi ma ibu ahụ dị mma iweli ma kọwaa ihe kpatara ya, na-enweta opekata mpe mkpebi ibu 4 n'ime 5 ziri ezi.
Data plate na-egosi ibu kacha ụgbọ ahụ nwere ike iweli na otu load center. Load center bụ ogologo site n'ihu forks ruo n'etiti (center of gravity) ibu ahụ. A na-ahazi ọtụtụ forklift maka load center nke inch 24. Ọ bụrụ na etiti ibu ahụ dị anya karịa nke ahụ, ma ọ bụ na e tinyere ihe mgbakwunye (attachment) n'ụgbọ ahụ, ibu ọ nwere ike iweli n'enweghị nsogbu na-ebelata: lelee plate ahụ ma jụọ onye isi gị.
Forklift na-eguzo dị ka seesaw n'elu taya ihu ya. Ibu dị na forks nọ n'otu akụkụ; ụgbọ na counterweight nọ n'akụkụ nke ọzọ. Ibu dị arọ karịa, ibu dị anya n'ihu, ma ọ bụ ibu e buliri elu ma tụgharịa n'ihu nwere ike ime ka ụgbọ ahụ daa n'ihu. Ịtụgharị ngwa ngwa nwere ike ime ka ọ daa n'akụkụ.
Buli naanị ibu kwụsiri ike nke dị n'ime ike ụgbọ ahụ. Tinye ibu ahụ n'etiti forks, ma tinye forks n'okpuru ya opekata mpe ụzọ abụọ n'ime ụzọ atọ nke ogologo ibu ahụ. Buli ya ntakịrị, tụgharịa mast azụ ntakịrị ka ibu ahụ dabere na backrest, ma debe ya n'ala.
Nzọụkwụ n'otu n'otu:
- Chọpụta ịdị arọ ibu ahụ (akara, akwụkwọ ma ọ bụ jụọ).
- Gụọ data plate: ike iweli (capacity) na load center.
- Etiti ibu ahụ ọ dị n'ime load center? Ịdị arọ ya ọ dị n'okpuru capacity?
- Ibu ahụ ọ kwụsiri ike, e kechiri ya, o mebighị?
- Ọ bụrụ ee: tinye ya n'etiti, forks opekata mpe ụzọ abụọ n'ime atọ n'okpuru, buli ntakịrị, tụgharịa azụ. Ọ bụrụ mba ma ọ bụ obi abụọ: kwụsị ma jụọ.
Okwu ị kwesịrị ịmara:
- Capacity: ibu kacha forklift nwere ike iweli n'enweghị nsogbu, nke e gosiri na data plate.
- Load center: ogologo site n'ihu forks ruo n'etiti ibu ahụ.
- Center of gravity: ebe ịdị arọ ihe na-aha nhata.
- Tipover: mgbe forklift dara n'ihu ma ọ bụ n'akụkụ ya.
Ebe ozi a pụrụ ịtụkwasị obi:
- OSHA eTool: Load handling
- OSHA 29 CFR 1910.178: Powered industrial trucks (the federal forklift rule)
Nwaa ugbu a: Naanị omume, ọnụọgụ e chepụtara. Plate otu ụgbọ kwuru 4,000 lb na load center nke inch 24. Kpebie ee ma ọ bụ mba, ya na ihe kpatara ya: (1) pallet 3,200 lb, n'etiti ma e kechiri ya; (2) igbe 4,600 lb; (3) ibu 2,500 lb na-adabe n'otu akụkụ ma dọwaa; (4) ibu 3,000 lb nke etiti ya dị anya karịa inch 24. Dee ihe ị ga-eme maka nke ọ bụla.
Ugbu a ị nwere ike ịgụ data plate ma kpebie ma ibu dị mma iweli, ma kwuo ihe kpatara ya.

check.q: Plate kwuru 5,000 lb na inch 24. Ibu ahụ dị 5,800 lb. Gịnị ka ị ga-eme?
options: Tinye mmadụ n'azụ dị ka ịdị arọ mgbakwunye
Ebulila ya; gwa onye isi gị
Buli ya elu ka ọ ha nhata
check.why: Ebulila ihe karịrị capacity e dere ede; a dịghị ekwe ka mmadụ nọkwasị n'ụgbọ mgbe ọ bụla.

check.q: Forks kwesịrị ịbanye n'okpuru ibu ruo ole?
options: Opekata mpe ụzọ abụọ n'ime ụzọ atọ nke ogologo ibu ahụ
Gafee ruo na pallet ọzọ dị n'azụ ya
check.why: Ndụmọdụ OSHA bụ opekata mpe ụzọ abụọ n'ime atọ nke ogologo ibu ahụ, n'akụghị ibu ndị dị n'azụ ya.

lessons.title: Ihe ọmụmụ 5: Ịnya ụgbọ, dock na ịdọba ụgbọ n'enweghị nsogbu
lessons.text:
Ihe ọmụmụ 5 n'ime 6 · ihe dị ka nkeji 6
Ebumnuche: Họrọ ihe kacha enweghị nsogbu mgbe ị na-anya ụgbọ, na dock na mgbe ị na-adọba ya.
Ihe ọmụmụ a na-akwado gị maka: Mgbe e nyere gị ọnọdụ ịnya ụgbọ, ịtụkọ ibu, dock ma ọ bụ ịdọba ụgbọ, ị ga-enwe ike ịhọrọ ihe kacha enweghị nsogbu dị ka iwu OSHA si kwuo, na-enweta opekata mpe ọnọdụ 4 n'ime 5 ziri ezi.
Jiri ibu dị n'ala ma tụgharịa azụ gaa ije, ọ bụghị mgbe e buliri ya elu ma ọ bụ tụgharịa ya n'ihu. Nya ụgbọ n'ọsọ ga-ekwe ka ị kwụsị n'enweghị nsogbu, ma belata ọsọ n'ala mmiri, n'ebe ị na-atụgharị na n'ebe ụzọ abụọ zutere (cross aisle). Kụọ horn n'ebe ụzọ zutere na n'akụkụ ebe ị na-ahụghị ihe. Lee ebe ị na-aga. Ọ bụrụ na ibu ahụ egbochie anya gị, nya ụgbọ azụ. Nọrọ ihe dị ka ogologo ụgbọ atọ n'azụ ụgbọ ọzọ.
Ndị mmadụ: ọ dịghị onye na-eguzo ma ọ bụ na-agafe n'okpuru forks e buliri elu, ma ibu dị na ya ma ọ bụ na ọ dịghị. Ọ dịghị onye na-anọkwasị n'ụgbọ ma ọ bụrụ na ụgbọ ahụ enweghị ebe dị mma maka ha ma a nyeghị ha ikike. Anyala ụgbọ gakwuru onye guzo n'ihu mgbidi ma ọ bụ shelf.
Ramp: jee nwayọọ. Mgbe ibu dị, debe ibu ahụ n'akụkụ elu: nya n'ihu mgbe ị na-arịgo, nya azụ mgbe ị na-arịda. Atụgharịla mgbe ọ bụla n'elu ramp. Dock: tupu ị banye n'ime trailer, a ga-adọrịrị breki trailer ahụ ma tinye wheel chock n'azụ taya ya; lelee ala trailer ahụ ma ọ nwere ebe gbajiri agbaji ma ọ bụ ebe na-adịghị ike; nọrọ anya n'ọnụ dock.
Ịdọba ụgbọ: ọ bụrụ na ị hapụ ụgbọ ahụ (ma ọ bụ ị nọ ụkwụ 25 ma ọ bụ karịa n'ebe ọ nọ, ma ọ bụ na ị naghị ahụ ya), wedata forks ruo n'ala, tinye ihe nchịkwa na neutral, gbanyụọ ya ma dọọ breki; gbochie taya ya n'ebe dị nrịgo. Ọ bụrụ na ụgbọ a na-anọdụ ala anya amalite ịda: awụpụla. Nọrọ n'oche ya na seatbelt gị, jide steering ike, kwụsie ụkwụ gị ike ma dabere n'akụkụ na-abụghị ebe ọ na-ada.
Nzọụkwụ n'otu n'otu:
- Ibu n'ala, tụgharịa azụ; horn n'ebe ụzọ zutere; lee ebe ị na-aga.
- Ibu egbochie anya gị: nya ụgbọ azụ.
- Ramp: ibu n'akụkụ elu, atụgharịla n'elu ramp.
- Dock: breki trailer adọrọ, wheel chock, ala e lelere.
- Ịdọba: forks n'ala, neutral, gbanyụọ, dọọ breki.
- Ọ na-ada: nọrọ n'ime, seatbelt, jide ike, dabere n'akụkụ ọzọ.
Okwu ị kwesịrị ịmara:
- Cross aisle: ebe ụzọ abụọ zutere, dị ka ebe ụzọ ụgbọ ala zutere.
- Wheel chock: ihe dị ka nkpọchi a na-etinye n'akụkụ taya ka trailer ghara ịgagharị.
- Ọnụ dock (dock edge): ọnụ loading dock ebe ala na-akwụsị ma dawa.
- Hapụrụ naanị ya (unattended): ị nọ ụkwụ 25 ma ọ bụ karịa n'ebe ụgbọ ahụ nọ, ma ọ bụ na ị naghị ahụ ya.
Ebe ozi a pụrụ ịtụkwasị obi:
- OSHA eTool: Traveling and maneuvering
- OSHA eTool: Loading docks
- OSHA 29 CFR 1910.178: Powered industrial trucks (the federal forklift rule)
Nwaa ugbu a: Mee kaadị akpa nwere ndepụta abụọ: "Tupu m banye n'ime trailer" na "Mgbe m na-adọba ụgbọ". Wee zaa okwu omume a n'ide ihe: ị na-ebu ibu dị ogologo nke na-egbochi anya gị, ị ga-arịdakwa ramp. Gịnị ka ị ga-eme?
Ugbu a ị nwere ike ịhọrọ ihe kacha enweghị nsogbu mgbe ị na-anya ụgbọ, na dock, n'elu ramp, mgbe ị na-adọba ya na ma ụgbọ amalite ịda.

check.q: Onye ọrụ ibe gị chọrọ iguzo n'okpuru forks gị e buliri elu iji dozie akara. Gịnị ka ị ga-ekwu?
options: "Naanị ma ọ bụrụ na ọ dịghị ihe dị na forks."
"Naanị ma ọ bụrụ na i yi okpu ígwè."
"Mba. Ọ dịghị onye na-aga n'okpuru forks e buliri elu. Aga m ebu ụzọ wedata ha."
check.why: OSHA amachibidoro onye ọ bụla iguzo ma ọ bụ ịgafe n'okpuru forks e buliri elu, ma ibu dị ma ọ bụ na ọ dịghị.

check.q: Forklift gị a na-anọdụ ala anya amalite ịda. Gịnị ka ị ga-eme?
options: Nọrọ n'oche, seatbelt gị, jide steering ma dabere n'akụkụ ọzọ
check.why: N'ụgbọ a na-anọdụ ala anya, ịnọ n'ime ya na seatbelt bụ otu ị ga-esi zere ka ọ ghara ịpịa gị.

lessons.title: Ihe ọmụmụ 6: Inweta ọzụzụ na ọrụ dị ka onye na-anya forklift
lessons.text:
Ihe ọmụmụ 6 n'ime 6 · ihe dị ka nkeji 5
Ebumnuche: Dee atụmatụ ka a zụọ gị ma nyochaa gị, na otu ahịrị eziokwu maka résumé.
Ihe ọmụmụ a na-akwado gị maka: Site n'iji ihe OSHA chọrọ n'aka ndị were mmadụ n'ọrụ, ị ga-enwe ike ide atụmatụ ka a zụọ gị ma nyochaa gị, na otu ahịrị eziokwu maka résumé, nke na-akpọ aha ọrụ onye were gị n'ọrụ ma na-adịghị ekwu na i nwere asambodo i nweghị.
Ọtụtụ ndị nwe ụlọ nkwakọba ngwaahịa, ebe nkesa ngwaahịa na ụlọ ahịa na-ewe mmadụ maka ọrụ warehouse nkịtị, wee zụọ ha n'ịnya forklift. Ụfọdụ ụlọ ọrụ na-enye ọrụ (staffing agency), workforce center na community college na-emekwa ọzụzụ forklift nwere omume aka. Jụọ ma ọ gụnyere ịnya ụgbọ n'okpuru onye nkuzi na nyocha omume.
Cheta: ebe ọ bụla a zụrụ gị, onye ọ bụla ọhụrụ were gị n'ọrụ ga-ahụ na a zụrụ gị ma nyochaa gị maka ụgbọ ya na ebe ọrụ ya tupu ị nya naanị gị. Ọzụzụ ị nwetaburu na-enyere aka, onye were gị n'ọrụ nwekwara ike ghara imegharị isiokwu ndị ị mụtaworo ma e nyochaworo gị na ha.
Na résumé gị, kwuo eziokwu. Ọ bụrụ na i mechara ihe ọmụmụ a, dee na i mechara ọzụzụ ihe ọmụma nchekwa forklift. Ọ bụrụ na onye were gị n'ọrụ zụrụ gị ma nyochaa gị, dee ụdị ụgbọ na afọ ahụ. Edela "certified" mgbe ọ bụla ma ọ bụrụ na i nwetaghị asambodo.
N'ajụjụ ọnụ ọrụ (interview), kwuo maka nlele tupu ọrụ amalite, data plate na nchekwa ndị na-eje ije. Ndị were mmadụ n'ọrụ chọrọ ndị na-anya ya na-akpachara anya mbụ, ma na-eme ngwa ngwa nke abụọ.
Nzọụkwụ n'otu n'otu:
- Depụta ndị were mmadụ n'ọrụ ma ọ bụ mmemme atọ dị gị nso na-azụ ndị na-anya forklift (ebe ọrụ, workforce center, community college).
- Jụọ nke ọ bụla: ọ gụnyere ịnya ụgbọ n'okpuru onye nkuzi na nyocha?
- Dee otu ahịrị eziokwu maka résumé gbasara ihe i meworo ruo ugbu a.
- Mụọ azịza sekọnd 30: "Kedu otu ị na-esi echebe onwe gị na forklift?"
Okwu ị kwesịrị ịmara:
- Staffing agency: ụlọ ọrụ na-etinye ndị ọrụ n'ọrụ n'azụmahịa ndị ọzọ.
- Workforce center: ọfịs ọha (a na-akpọkarị ya American Job Center) na-enyere ndị mmadụ aka ịchọta ọrụ na ọzụzụ.
Ebe ozi a pụrụ ịtụkwasị obi:
- OSHA 29 CFR 1910.178: Powered industrial trucks (the federal forklift rule)
- OSHA eTool: Operator training
Nwaa ugbu a: Dee atụmatụ gị: ebe atọ nwere ike ịzụ gị, ajụjụ ị ga-ajụ nke ọ bụla, otu ahịrị eziokwu maka résumé, na azịza sekọnd 30 gị maka "Kedu otu ị na-esi echebe onwe gị na forklift?" Gụpụta azịza ahụ n'olu dị elu.
Ugbu a ị nwere ike ide atụmatụ iji nweta ọzụzụ na nyocha forklift ma kọwaa ọzụzụ gị n'eziokwu na résumé.
Otu e si enyocha ọrụ ikpeazụ gị:
Ihe anyị na-ele anya Ọ bụbeghị O ruru O karịrị Ndepụta nlele Nlele igodo gbanyụrụ ma ọ bụ igodo gbanyere adịghị, ma ọ bụ enweghị nzọụkwụ maka ụgbọ na-adịghị mma. Ọ kpuchiri ihe niile mgbe igodo gbanyụrụ na mgbe ọ gbanyere maka ụdị ụgbọ a họọrọ, ma kwuo ihe a ga-eme maka mmebi. Ọ gbakwunyere nlele ndị ọzọ maka ụgbọ eletrik ma ọ bụ propane. Aha akụkụ Akụkụ a kpọrọ aha erughị isii, ma ọ bụ ọrụ ha ezighi ezi. Opekata mpe akụkụ isii a kpọrọ aha ya na ọrụ nke ọ bụla, na otu (class) ụgbọ ahụ. Ọ kọwara otu counterweight na load backrest si echebe onye na-anya ya. Mkpebi ibu A kpọrọ ibu karịrị capacity ma ọ bụ nke na-akwụsighị ike ihe dị mma. Mkpebi ibu atọ niile ziri ezi, ya na ihe kpatara ha site na data plate. Ọ kwuru mgbe a ga-ajụ onye isi, dị ka mgbe a maghị ịdị arọ ma ọ bụ mgbe e nwere attachment. Kaadị ịnya ụgbọ, dock na ịdọba Nlele dock ma ọ bụ otu nzọụkwụ ịdọba adịghị. Ọ depụtara nzọụkwụ dock (breki, wheel chock, ala) na nzọụkwụ anọ niile nke ịdọba. Ọ gbakwunyere iwu ramp, ndị na-eje ije na ịda ụgbọ. Atụmatụ ọzụzụ na ahịrị résumé Ọ na-ekwu na o nwere asambodo, ma ọ bụ na ọ dịghị mkpa ọzụzụ onye were ya n'ọrụ. Ọ kpọrọ aha ebe atọ a ga-azụ ya, kwuo na onye were ya n'ọrụ ga-enyocha ya, ma nye otu ahịrị eziokwu maka résumé. Ọ gụnyere azịza nchekwa sekọnd 30 a mụrụ maka ajụjụ ọnụ ọrụ. Iji gafee: Ruru eru ma ọ bụ Karịrị n'ahịrị ọ bụla. Ọ bụrụ na ahịrị bụ Ọ ruchabeghị, dozie akụkụ ahụ ma nwaa ọzọ.

check.q: I mechara ihe ọmụmụ a, mana ọ dịbeghị onye were gị n'ọrụ nyochara gị. Kedu ahịrị résumé bụ eziokwu?
check.why: Ọ na-ekwu kpọmkwem ihe i mere, n'ekwughị na i nwere asambodo i nweghị.

check.q: Gịnị ka ị kwesịrị ịjụ mmemme ọzụzụ forklift?
options: Ma ọ gụnyere ịnya ụgbọ n'okpuru onye nkuzi na nyocha omume
Ma ọ na-enye kaadị mara mma
Ma ị nwere ike ịwụfe akụkụ omume aka
Ma ọ bụ nke kacha dị ọnụ ala n'ịntanetị
check.why: Ọzụzụ OSHA gụnyere omume aka na nyocha, ya mere lelee na mmemme ahụ nwere ha.
